I also grow some cotton, but I will not put too much land into it because it needs more watching and more picking, and my family has some off-farm work so labor is tighter. Since I have well irrigation, I will use it to protect wheat at key stages and give maize and cotton enough water when the weather turns dry. I will use improved or hybrid seed where it helps yield and stability, keep fertilizer moderate instead of excessive, and do normal pest control only when needed. For tillage, I will use rotary tillage on most fields because it is practical for me and suits my usual way of farming. I am aiming for stable output more than taking big risks.
